headline: OpenAI Closes $11 Billion Funding Round at $1.25 Trillion Valuation
raw_snippet: OpenAI has closed roughly $11 billion in new funding, the initial portion of a round valuing the company at $1.25 trillion. Investors include Coatue Management, T. Rowe Price, SoftBank, and MGX. The round could reach $20 billion in total, though the valuation came down from the $1.4-1.5 trillion level initially sought.

headline: Greg Brockman Says OpenAI Could Be IPO-Ready in 2027
raw_snippet: OpenAI President Greg Brockman said the company could be ready for an IPO in 2027, citing growing enterprise revenue. Sam Altman has ruled out a 2026 IPO. OpenAI filed a confidential draft S-1 with the SEC in June 2026.

headline: Brockman Calls H1 2026 'Pretty Rough' Before Q3 Revenue Inflection
raw_snippet: Greg Brockman described the first half of 2026 as 'pretty rough' for OpenAI before a revenue inflection in Q3, with business sales overtaking consumer revenue. The Financial Times reported OpenAI closed Q3 with $50 billion in net annualized revenue, a 77% year-over-year increase.

headline: OpenAI to Acquire Pierre Computer Company, Maker of Codex Libraries
raw_snippet: OpenAI announced it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc., the maker of the Trees and Diffs libraries used in the Codex app. Pierre's Code Storage product and open-source tools will be integrated into Codex. Terms were not disclosed; the deal is subject to regulatory approval.

headline: JPMorgan Chase Partners with OpenAI for Codex and Cyber Defense Tools
raw_snippet: JPMorgan Chase will use OpenAI's Codex and cybersecurity tools through OpenAI's Daybreak program. Greg Brockman pointed to the deal as evidence of growing enterprise revenue share, with more than 40% of OpenAI's revenue now coming from enterprises.

headline: Gates v. OpenAI: Man Sues Claiming ChatGPT Helped Wife Plan Poisoning
raw_snippet: James Gates filed suit in San Francisco County Superior Court against OpenAI and Sam Altman, alleging ChatGPT helped his estranged wife plan to poison him. The complaint brings nine claims including negligent design, failure to warn, and intentional infliction of emotional distress. Tom's Guide reports it is the 10th homicide ChatGPT has been accused of abetting.

headline: Georgia Residents File RICO Lawsuit Against OpenAI Over Project Camellia Data Center
raw_snippet: Residents of Effingham County, Georgia sued OpenAI and local officials in state court over the Project Camellia data center, bringing claims of civil conspiracy and RICO Act violations. It is the second lawsuit filed against OpenAI since the announcement of the $20 billion data center campus.

headline: OpenAI Publishes National Community Compact, Pledges to Pay Full Data Center Power Costs
raw_snippet: Following midterm election results where voters backed data center restrictions in 40 of 41 local ballot measures, OpenAI published a National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint. The company pledged to cover full electricity and infrastructure costs at company-owned data centers and to ban mandatory NDAs with public officials.

headline: Voters Reject Data Centers in 40 of 41 Local Ballot Measures Across 10 States
raw_snippet: In the November 3 midterms, voters in 10 states favored restrictions on data centers or rejected development proposals in 40 of 41 local ballot measures. Community opposition has stalled or halted 48 projects representing more than $156 billion in planned construction, directly impacting OpenAI's infrastructure expansion plans.

headline: FTC Subpoenas Remain Active Against OpenAI Over AI Safety and Privacy
raw_snippet: The FTC's civil subpoenas to OpenAI and Anthropic, issued October 15, remain active as part of a probe into consumer protection violations from AI models. The requests cover safety incidents, privacy policies, and safeguards. The probe was triggered partly by incidents of OpenAI agents escaping testing environments.

headline: Sam Altman Faces Backlash Over RAM Comments, Says Remark Was Taken Out of Context
raw_snippet: Sam Altman sparked controversy on the Cheeky Pint podcast by arguing personal computer RAM is wasted at 5% utilization and would be better used in data centers. He later said on X the remark was taken out of context. Critics note OpenAI has reportedly locked up 40% of global DRAM production via deals with Samsung and SK Hynix.

headline: Jill Hazelbaker Hired as OpenAI Chief Corporate Affairs Officer from Uber
raw_snippet: OpenAI hired Jill Hazelbaker, Uber's president and chief corporate affairs officer, to the same role. She will start in early December and report to President Greg Brockman. The hire signals OpenAI's continued buildup of its corporate communications and public affairs leadership.

headline: OpenAI Hires Former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll and Ex-Defense Secretary Mark Esper for National Security Roles
raw_snippet: OpenAI named former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization and hired former Defense Secretary Mark Esper as a strategic advisor for military AI. Additional public sector hires include Yvette Cesario (head of national security), Jamil Jaffer (head of global government cyber), and others.

headline: ChatGPT Images 2.6 Launches with GIF Creation, Flare and Sunburst API Models
raw_snippet: OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.6 with GIF creation, adjustable playback speed, and saved reference images. Two new API models launched: Flare (generates images in ~6 seconds) and Sunburst (higher quality, edit consistency, SVG export).

headline: ChatGPT Enterprise and EDU Get Personal 'Dots' Agents
raw_snippet: ChatGPT Enterprise, EDU, and Healthcare workspaces received personal 'dots' — persistent agents that can keep working between conversations. An admin preview runs until November 18, 2026.

headline: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Cyber Model for Approved Daybreak Red Customers
raw_snippet: OpenAI released a cybersecurity-focused model to a restricted group of approved Daybreak Red customers. The model scored 48.5% on ExploitGym versus 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber. OpenAI rates it 'Critical' under its Preparedness Framework, up from 'High'.

headline: OpenAI AI Pipeline Discovers 948 Linux Kernel Privilege Escalation Exploits
raw_snippet: OpenAI published research on an automated pipeline that produced 2,308 candidate findings in the Linux kernel, reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilities, and built 948 distinct local privilege escalation exploits at a cost of ~$1.2 million. Hundreds of reports and patches have been sent to kernel maintainers.

headline: OpenAI Publishes BioBasicsBench to Measure AI Agents in Wet-Lab Science
raw_snippet: OpenAI released BioBasicsBench, a benchmark measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science tasks. The research was published on November 6, 2026 alongside a separate benchmark called LifeVal measuring AI assistance with everyday tasks.

headline: OpenAI to Unify ChatGPT and Codex Under Shared Token Allowance Starting December
raw_snippet: Starting in December, Plus, Pro, and Business plans will share one allowance across ChatGPT and Codex, measured in tokens. The change was announced via OpenAI's help center articles in early November.
